import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_ineq_nto1onlt2m1on
  (n : ℕ) :
  (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ 2 - 1 / n := by
  -- Case n = 0
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · subst hn0
    norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv]
  · -- Case n > 0
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0)
    
    -- Case n = 1
    by_cases hn1 : n = 1
    · subst hn1
      norm_num
    · -- Case n ≥ 2
      have hn_ge2 : 2 ≤ n := by
        contrapose! hn1
        omega
      
      -- Lemma: n ≤ (3/2)^n for n ≥ 2
      have h_bound : (n : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n := by
        have h_aux : ∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k → (k : ℝ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
          intro k hk
          induction' hk with k hk IH
          · norm_num
          · cases k
            · norm_num at hk
            · simp_all [pow_succ, mul_assoc]
              norm_num at *
              nlinarith [pow_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 2) k]
        exact h_aux n hn_ge2
      
      -- Deduce n^(1/n) ≤ 3/2
      have h_root : (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 := by
        have h_base_pos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by positivity
        have h_rhs_pos : 0 < (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
        
        -- We have n ≤ (3/2)^n. Taking n-th root preserves inequality.
        -- Using rpow properties: (a^b)^(1/b) = a for a > 0.
        have h_pow_n : ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) = 3 / 2 := by
          rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by norm_num)]
          field_simp [hpos.ne']
          ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
          
        have h_le_root : (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) := by
          apply Real.rpow_le_rpow
          · positivity
          · linarith
          · positivity
          
        calc
          (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) := h_le_root
          _ = 3 / 2 := by rw [h_pow_n]
      
      -- Compare 3/2 with 2 - 1/n
      have h_right : (3 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (2 : ℝ) - 1 / n := by
        have h_inv : (1 : ℝ) / n ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
          · positivity
          · exact_mod_cast hn_ge2
        linarith
      
      calc
        (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / n : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 := h_root
        _ ≤ 2 - 1 / n := h_right
